description: Glaciers is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by GeoBC Branch. Glaciers is a multi-part polygon dataset representing the 2021 extent of glaciers in British Columbia. This dataset may be used to represent the most current glacier extent for the province of British Columbia. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher GeoBC Branch. Its tags are climate change, glacial, glacial features, glacier, glaciers. It offers 3 resource(s) in MULTIPLE, OTHER, WMS. The portal shows 2024-04-06 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Licence - University of Northern British Columbia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
